purpose: Portable config template for an EXTERNAL-environment judge runner (run_b1_3_v3_judges.py). Placeholders only; no credentials, no execution. Fill in the external env where cross-family judge access exists.

single_family_pilot_downgrade.reporting: result MUST be labeled a single-family pilot with a weak-blinding / generator-adjacency caveat; subject to the scorer's single-model-family-dominance guard

system_prompt: You are a careful annotator. Follow the instructions exactly. Answer with a single letter only, optionally followed by a confidence line. Do not explain.

blinding.note: arm_left/arm_right are copied from the stimulus into the judge-output row for SCORING only, never shown to the model

invalid_policy.parse: map output to A|B; else parse_status in {unparseable, refused, malformed, tie} and invalid_flag=true

position_balancing: already baked into stimuli via position_seed; runner must NOT re-order options
freeze_prerequisites: provider/family panel selected (>=2 families or explicit single-family-pilot)
16 active artifact hashes re-confirmed vs freeze manifest (no change)
invalid_run_conditions: single-family dominance when not explicitly downgraded
threshold or scorer edits after freeze
disallowed_labels: LLM_OBJECT_MODULATION_SIGNAL (until earned by a frozen scored run)
